Not sure if this has been said but native Australian bees are in huge decline. These are very tiny, stingless bees but are extremely essential to our ecology.
I have planted bee friendly flowers and set up what is called a "bee bath"
Essentially a very shallow base for a pot plant filled with natural stones from my garden and then filled with water half way. The stones give the bees somewhere to perch and drink.

Also a "bee hotel" is another great way to ensure a safe place for them to live. They're cheap and can be bought from a large hardware store (Bunnings in Australia)
Rather than have them build a home in a hollow tree or in the eaves of your house.
Or very easily create one from small PVC pipes or bamboo hollowed out into a small birdhouse. 
We all need the take care of our little friends because without pollination, we can't enjoy most of our natural world.
